subject: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge
body:
MESSAGE 1/6
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 2, 2025 at 9:12 AM -0800
Subject: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge

Team — we need to lock pilot customers for Phase 2 of signed offline bundles (Redwood Private on-prem/VPC + offline install + signature verify).

Proposal: 2–3 pilots in December → early January, chosen to hit different constraints:

1) Helios Defense (strict air-gap + offline media transfer)
- High urgency + strong security engagement.
- Known pain: transport integrity + installer version drift.

2) AsterBank (regulated; heavy audit trail requirements)
- Will stress audit events + evidence questions.
- Procurement/legal already asking about key custody + rotation.

3) Northbridge Health (on-prem POC; “offline but not fully air-gapped”)
- Good for validating the “offline bundle, no outbound fetch” path + docs clarity.

Success metrics for pilot (proposed):
- Install/upgrade completes with signature verification ON (no break-glass) in each env.
- Preflight “verify bundle” output is understandable to customer ops (Support can triage w/ minimal back-and-forth).
- Zero false negatives due to time skew OR clear remediation that works without internet.
- Audit events generated locally for verify success/failure (and export path validated where applicable).
- Documentation package: customer guide + internal runbook “green” (SE/Support sign-off).

Timeline target:
- Customer outreach + scheduling this week
- First pilot installs start week of Dec 15 (aim)
- Pilot exits by Jan 9 so we can hit the January Private release train.

Asks:
- Connor: any release-train constraints / what build do you need locked by?
- Aisha/Marcus: any security must-haves before we put this in front of customers (esp. key rotation, trust store story)?
- Neha: operational readiness gates you want for pilot (alerts, on-call, escalation)?

Attached: initial pilot selection matrix + GA criteria draft. Happy to adjust list if there’s a better mix.

— Vivek

Attachment: SignedOfflineBundles_PilotSelectionMatrix_v2.xlsx
Attachment: OfflineBundles_GA_Criteria_Draft_20251202.docx

MESSAGE 2/6
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 2, 2025 at 10:01 AM -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge

Works for me in principle.

Release constraints:
- If we want pilots starting week of Dec 15, we need an RC bundle cut by Dec 10–11 so we have time to validate verification paths in staging and run the tamper tests.
- “No outbound fetch” behavior must be landed before RC (otherwise we’ll see inconsistent behavior between customer environments).
- I’d like a hard gate: no Private release artifact cut unless (a) bundle signed, (b) installer preflight verification passes, (c) downgrade prevention test passes.

One concern: if Helios is truly air-gapped, key rotation/trust store update story has to be simple (file drop + documented procedure). If we’re not ready for rotation in the pilot window, we should explicitly state “no key rotation during pilot” and do the drill internally.

If you confirm customer scheduling by end of week, I’ll align our signing stage timelines.

— Connor

MESSAGE 3/6
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 2, 2025 at 11:22 AM -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge

Pilot list looks good.

Security must-haves before we put this in front of customers:
1) Fail closed on verification
- Unknown key / invalid signature / manifest mismatch => block install by default.
- Break-glass must log loudly + require an explicit flag (and be policy-gated in docs).

2) Provenance/integrity messaging
- Customer-facing: we sign the manifest; the manifest includes hashes of all artifacts.
- Internal: ensure our pipeline publishes the signature + public key identifier in a consistent place.

3) Downgrade/replay protection
- Signed version metadata should prevent “older signed bundle” installs unless an explicit rollback procedure is followed.

4) Time skew handling
- Air-gapped environments often have weird clocks. We should not rely on online time.
- If signature validity windows are used, we need a documented remediation (time sync guidance, optional diagnostic override, etc.).

AsterBank will ask about key custody and rotation. I suggest we prep a short “Signing 101” pack (what algorithm, where keys live, who can sign, audit evidence) even if we don’t share all internals.

— Marcus

---

MESSAGE 4/6
From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 2, 2025 at 12:08 PM -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge

Agree with Marcus.

Two additions from a customer-review posture:
- We need a crisp statement for pilots: “Redwood will not request outbound connectivity; verification is performed offline.” (This comes up in regulated environments.)
- Evidence: we should be able to show (if asked) that the signing keys are protected and signing events are auditable (even if details are high-level).

Pilot success metrics: please add “support escalation readiness” as a metric (i.e., if a pilot hits verification failure, we can diagnose within 1 business day with a known log bundle path and standard error taxonomy).

Also: I’d prefer we keep pilot count at 2 if we’re not fully confident in operational readiness. Helios + AsterBank are the highest value. Northbridge is optional if the team bandwidth is there.

— Aisha

---

MESSAGE 5/6
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 2, 2025 at 1:41 PM -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge

+1. Operational gates I want before we put a pilot on the calendar:

- Clear runbook for verification failures (hash mismatch, unknown key, not-yet-valid/expired, downgrade prevented)
- Support bundle includes signed bundle metadata + verification outcome (so we’re not spelunking through customer systems)
- Named on-call escalation path for the pilot window (primary + backup)
- Known workaround policy: when is break-glass acceptable, what must be captured, who approves

We can start with 2 pilots (Helios, AsterBank) and add Northbridge only if the first two are stable (i.e., no unknown unknowns in week 1).

— Neha

---

MESSAGE 6/6
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 4:48 PM -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot customer selection (air-gapped) for signed offline bundles — propose Helios / AsterBank / Northbridge

Thanks all — aligning on 2-pilot plan to start.

Decision:
- Pilot #1: Helios Defense
- Pilot #2: AsterBank
- Optional Pilot #3: Northbridge Health (only if Helios/AsterBank are stable by end of first pilot week)

Updated pilot success metrics (roll-up):
1) Security/Integrity
- Verification fails closed by default; unknown key invalid sig or manifest mismatch blocks install.
- Downgrade prevention validated (attempted install of older signed bundle is blocked with actionable message).
- Break-glass path exists but is explicitly approved + produces prominent audit markers.

2) Operability
- Installer produces a single “verify report” output usable by Support/SE.
- Support bundle includes manifest + signature verification status + key id.
- Runbook exists for top failure modes with log locations and decision tree.

3) Customer experience
- Air-gapped statement confirmed: no outbound connectivity required.
- First successful install/upgrade in each pilot environment in <= 4 hours of hands-on time (excluding internal scheduling).
- If failures occur, Redwood can triage within 1 business day (per Aisha’s metric).

Timeline:
- Connor’s RC target: Dec 10–11 (agreed). I will not schedule installs before we have the RC validated.
- Outreach to Helios/AsterBank this week with a proposed install window the week of Dec 15.

Action items:
- Connor: confirm which installer version we’ll require for pilots + any gating checklist items to share internally.
- Marcus/Aisha: provide 1–2 paragraphs of “Signing 101” language for customer security reviewers (high-level, no sensitive key internals).
- Neha: nominate primary/backup escalation for pilot week + confirm runbook ownership.

I’ll update PM-907 and the launch brief tracker (drive link in related docs) with the above and send a separate note to CS/SE to coordinate scheduling.

— Vivek
